basis.quote: For the last two days my stools have been black and tarry
basis.interpretation: Melena (black tarry stools) indicates upper gastrointestinal bleeding, a time-critical condition requiring immediate evaluation and hemostasis capability

basis.quote: I've felt lightheaded when stand up
basis.interpretation: Orthostatic lightheadedness in the context of melena suggests volume depletion and active or recent significant bleeding, increasing urgency for emergency assessment

output.reason: Melena with orthostatic symptoms indicates acute GI hemorrhage requiring immediate emergency-department assessment, resuscitation capability, and possible transfusion or endoscopic intervention.
